shortDescription: Array Technologies NASDAQ:ARRY sinks 7.2% in Friday's trading as UBS downgraded the solar tracking manufacturer to Neutral from Buy with a $5 price target, slashed from $10, as the bank expects the use of preferred dividend payments through 2030 to reduce available cash for completing acquisitions…

children: sinks 7.2% in Friday's trading as UBS downgraded the solar tracking manufacturer to Neutral from Buy with a $5 price target, slashed from $10, as the bank expects the use of preferred dividend payments through 2030 to reduce available cash for completing acquisitions.

"The transition of preferred dividends from payment-in-kind to cash-pay changes the outlook for FCF deployment" by reducing "cash available for deleveraging and growth investment, particularly opportunistic M&A, while competitors broaden their platforms through consolidation," UBS analyst Jon Windham said in a note.
The analyst said he expects Array

will generate sufficient free cash flow to service the preferred dividends and estimates $162M of cumulative cash payments through 2030, but the company may have less flexibility to expand its product offering and defend its competitive position, increasing the company's reliance on organic growth and execution to deliver upside.
Windham said he remains positive on the direction of the U.S. solar industry, particularly for companies with domestic manufacturing footprints such as Array
, but he views the stock as fairly valued at ~5x estimated FY 2027 EV/EBITDA.

title: Array Technologies plunges as UBS downgrades, seeing less available cash for M&A
